Studied: First Aid.description:
🩹 Before this year you trained in emergency care: a fire department life-saving course, lifeguard certification or first-aid shifts at events.

🌱 Bleeding control, CPR and the AED, splints, burns and the recovery position. You work in order: make it safe, check breathing, call help, treat.
⚠️ Crush injuries, Quirk-caused wounds and many casualties at once still overwhelm you.
⚖️ You are no paramedic, nurse or doctor: no prescription drugs or procedures, and you hand patients over when professionals arrive.
🏫 It shows in gloves kept in your bag, a calm voice and a habit of watching everyone's breathing.

📈 Grants: First Aid +15
Studied: First Aid.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has trained in field first aid: bleeding control, CPR and the AED, splints, burn care, the recovery position and moving an injured person without making the injury worse. At an accident they work in order: make the scene safe, check breathing, call for help, treat. Prior study, not mastery: crush injuries, Quirk-caused wounds and many casualties at once still overwhelm them. Not a license: they are no paramedic, nurse or doctor, cannot give prescription drugs or perform procedures, and hand patients over when professionals arrive. It shows in gloves kept in a bag, a calm voice and a habit of watching everyone's breathing.
